title: Ch 5 — Act Two — The Plot Thickens

nodes.text: Ch 5 — Act Two
Wagner's Home
Wagner begins the day by getting out of bed, walking over to his turn-table and putting on an album.
All right.
Jacob's Home
Jacob watches his son waking up to start the day.
Faust's Home
Faust is gagging, he stumbles about disoriented.
Wagner's Home
Wagner is sitting on the porch, reading and smoking.
Jacob's Home
Jacob is cooking up schnitzel.
Faust's Home
Faust looks at himself through a crusty mirror.
The face in the glass is still half asleep, and does not look away first.
There is a knocking at his door and he goes to get it. It is Dickens Dean.
Forgive my mess, but I find it conducive to creativity. I can look at things in sedimentary layers and remember where in it something should be. Fossil finds in my own apartment.
The air you bring about you really changes the place, Dickens.
Yeah, I've been told that. I'd suspect you'd carry your specific voice and identity with you as well. Assuming those were your goals.
At this time in my life, I really just want to see to the happiness of my friends and family first. My ambitions while fierce, do not supersede their own closeness or proximity to me.
I've been neglectful or selfish enough to them in this existence alone, without bringing any other dimensions into the equation.

You know why I sought you out. You have a great potential to craft something I really want to see made. Well, lots of things I want to see made. I wouldn't say you alone, but you few, you special few.
Who are you exactly, I'm intrigued.
In my world, I was the fastest kid in town. I ran everywhere, I was always thinking on my feet. I was Forrest Gump but not retarded.
When I wasn't running, I was in a book, waiting tables, I ran to the edges of town and I got lost. I knew there was a bigger world out there just waiting. But I never left.
I just kept running those same streets. Looking up at the powerlines, seeing the strange connections running just under the surface.
I was the youngest person let into the Elk's Lodge, because I did so much work for them. I got them hooked up to the Internet, is all, but that's a big thing to old people.
Even better if you explain to them how awesome it all is. They see the spark in the eyes and just want to follow your gaze.
You were what, a broadband prophet.
In my world, I achieved way more pushing technology forward. Your trickle would not be felt for but a moment in the churning ocean of what I helped bring about.
A flood of information, pouring out across the world. Knowledge for all.
Sounds intense. Why do you want to hang with me?
You have a vision, from those of us who've learned to wander, they've spoken of you.
I hardly think I'm worthy to cross time and space. And besides, it sounds like my reality is awfully grungy to you, like you're slumming dude.
Sorry, no, that's not the impression I want to leave. I'm very much enjoying my travels. Think of me like a tourist.
Eyes always wide open and happy, staring out with mute fascination and wonder upon the fresh new world. It's my first time outside Small Wood, though I have watched from afar.
Faust's phone vibrates. He checks his text message.
From Habes. Hey, in town, wanted to catch up. Thinking of you.
Who is that from?
Someone I hadn't thought about in a very long time.
In a good way or bad.
It's never just one now is it?
Love lifes are complicated.
I imagine hopping between dimensions only complicates the deal.
You think girls are weird on this plane of existence, just you wait.
Ha, no spoilers.
Mind if I hang out with you and your friends today?
Why would I? You seem like you can hold your own.
Thanks, I appreciate it.
